user.description: The Thermostat calls this server in place of the Nest cloud.

data_description.port: The port that the server listens on. The Endpoint on the Thermostat must use this port.
data_description.advertised_url: The URL that the Thermostat calls back on. Use the LAN address of Home Assistant. The server adds the port if the URL has no port.

error.invalid_url: Enter an http:// or https:// URL with a host.
